claim_boundary: This artifact proves the sampled mean-value enclosure for the Base phase factor, fixed-power CFARI/AFARI equivalence, and tensor/Schur identities. It proves neither CFARI, AFARI, F4F, CRR-U, a witness, a cubic estimate, a density gain, a short-interval theorem, a full-method saturation theorem, or an L-function result.

crr_u_effect.statement: The truth status of CRR-U does not advance. A proof of either fixed-saving target would still imply CRR-U through the averaged-jitter reduction.

fixed_power_maps.afari_eta_to_cafari: AFARI_eta implies CFARI_(eta/2) for all sufficiently large v
fixed_power_maps.cfari_eta_to_afari: CFARI_eta implies AFARI_(eta/2) for all sufficiently large v
fixed_power_maps.f4f_zeta_to_cafari: F4F_zeta implies CFARI_(zeta/3) for all sufficiently large v
fixed_power_maps.scope: Each map absorbs only fixed constants, delta(v), and logarithmic/subpower factors; it is not an effective finite-v threshold.

extra_energy_gate.positive_cubic_boundary: No proved bridge connects the frozen PositiveCubic predicate to the Base phase or the mixed Schur kernel.
extra_energy_gate.proved_conditional_effect: F4F_zeta implies CFARI_(zeta/3) eventually through actual-Farey Cauchy plus the sampled phase upper
extra_energy_gate.scope: the least currently isolated non-tautological energy/Farey condition in this Cauchy chain; not claimed logically weakest among all arguments
extra_energy_gate.statement: F4F_zeta: integral_(U_v)|R_W(u)|^4du<=v^(20-zeta) for a fixed zeta>0 and every Base-admissible W

fixed_power_equivalence.afari_to_cafari: AFARI_eta implies CFARI_(eta/2) eventually, using Mcal<=(20Q/L)A and the sampled phase upper
fixed_power_equivalence.cfari_to_afari: CFARI_eta implies AFARI_(eta/2) eventually, using the Base phase lower and A<=(2L/Q)Mcal
fixed_power_equivalence.consequence: CFARI is a phase-sensitive reformulation, not an independent fixed-power gate beyond AFARI
fixed_power_equivalence.equivalence: exists fixed eta>0 CFARI_eta if and only if exists fixed eta>0 AFARI_eta

literature_boundary.boca_radziwill: The additive complete-Farey matrix e(n*a/q), n<=N, N asymp Q^2 is not the logarithmic-jitter K_F on arbitrary real W subset [0,Q^3]; its eigenvalue-moment result supplies no all-ones or mixed G_W/K_F bound here.
literature_boundary.ramare: The same additive uniform-weight Farey setting is studied; no direct log-node transfer is asserted.

phase_scale_enclosure.mean_value_translation: 1-separated sampling plus the classical coefficient-l2 Dirichlet mean-value estimate yields ||M_W||_op^2<=C(H+L)(1+log(2L))
phase_scale_enclosure.power_scale: a^*G_W*a=v^(20+o(1)) uniformly on the Base class
phase_scale_enclosure.scope: every Base-admissible common pair; no RationalMass, energy, or PositiveCubic hypothesis enters the upper bound

research_stage_review_policy.lightweight_checks: primary-source anchors, exact scale algebra, finite-dimensional kernel identities, replay, and tamper rejection

tensor_and_schur.four_linear_structure: the G pair and K_F pair are independent before a new mixed estimate is introduced
tensor_and_schur.scope: the Schur kernel is PSD but it is a diagonal mixed object, not the tensor product above
